# Critical_Exponent_Scaling

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Power-law scaling of physical quantities (e.g., correlation length, susceptibility) near a critical point, characterized by universal exponents. Enables prediction of system behavior near transitions, useful for designing robust and sensitive neuromorphic devices operating at criticality.
